preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= d_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points)
preconditions.description: Each point's coordinates must be valid integers within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(x_i > 0 and y_i > 0 for x_i, y_i in points)
preconditions.description: All points must have positive x and y coordinates.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the maximum number of moves c.
The number of moves printed must match the maximum number of moves c.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move must involve two distinct points within the valid range.
